#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-config-engine/tests/test_minigraph_case.py#L173-#L184
There's a new field 'dhcp_server' in device metadata, and yang model is not updated.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Follow test_minigraph_dhcp_server_feature to run sonic-cfggen command, and check device_metadata field.

#### Describe the results you received:
Output can't pass yang validation.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Output can pass yang validation.
